query:
SELECT s.companyName, m.status, COUNT(*) as meetingCount
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.sponsorId NOT IN (30001, 60001, 90001, 120001)
GROUP BY m.sponsorId, m.status
ORDER BY s.companyName
LIMIT 30;
